notes.text: Explicitly named in the Sotah baraita and a separate local notice.
The midrash explicitly reads Ilai bar Menaḥem. His separate article raises the possibility of a textual error when comparing Ilai and Elazar.
The local offspring list supports reading ben Menaḥem. The Yerushalmi name reads Elazar son of R. Menaḥem. Heilprin’s separate articles preserve the possible Ilai–Elazar confusion.
The Bavli supplies Menashya ben or bar Menaḥem in the discussion of the household that pressed pomegranates. The local expansion follows that patronymic.
